# Narrcorp

> Technology consulting, software engineering and specialist talent services.

- Website: https://narrcorp.com/
- Contact: hr@narrcorp.com
- Services: https://narrcorp.com/#services
- Approach: https://narrcorp.com/#why-narrcorp
- Practical guidance: https://narrcorp.com/#guidance

## Services

Technology strategy and roadmaps; workflow automation; software engineering and digital products; business system integration; data, analytics and applied AI; cloud platforms and delivery operations; quality, security and resilience; technology staffing and dedicated teams.

## Engagements

Staff augmentation, permanent hiring and dedicated teams are discussed according to the role or project requirements. Scope, responsibilities and working arrangements are agreed before an engagement begins.

## Content context

Industry examples are illustrative planning scenarios. Photography is illustrative. The website does not publish customer testimonials, verified outcome statistics, candidate availability or prices.
